prompt:
Use only the supplied current.db and README. All windows below are UTC and half-open, selected by logical-operation open time. A terminal-failure percentage has logical operations as its denominator; attempt-failure percentage has attempts as its denominator. Return only JSON matching the provided schema. Percentages use 0–100, differences use percentage points. evidence_sql must contain executable read-only SQLite queries with literal bounds, not pseudocode. Arrays may be in any order; include every requested group. A zero numerator is not missing data. No web or network access is needed.

Report ledger-sync reliability for 2026-05-09: reference 10:00–11:00 versus incident 11:00–12:00. Report the authoritative event source for these windows (registry version, event table, event grain and effective start). For each period and actual serving PHYSICAL pool, report logical operations, terminal failures, terminal-failure percentage, retried operations, retry percentage and mean end-to-end latency_ms. Do not treat routing intent or an individual execution identity as a physical pool. Also give all-pool operations, terminal failures and terminal-failure percentage per period; identify the physical pool with the largest increase and report that increase in pp. In assessment state what the report establishes and the important attribution/counting limitations.
